description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Owners: new package Storage.Mnesia and cohesive internal helpers, implementing Amarula profile-scoped callbacks plus explicit seed/readiness support from the approved contract. Extract transactional get/put/delete/clear/list and atomic seed-once behavior from ZAQ SessionStorage without ZAQ IDs, NodeRouter, Connect or database dependencies. Scope must distinguish host credential generations and profiles. Preserve configurable limits with ZAQ-compatible values, empty/missing vs unavailable errors, seed tombstones after clear, all-or-nothing oversized seed, and safe serialization responsibilities. Clear never affects another scope; do not dynamically create unbounded atoms.

Tests to add before implementation:
Add package integration/property tests before implementation for arbitrary keys/values supported by the contract, cross-scope isolation, concurrent writes and accurate capacity accounting, boundary sizes, missing entry vs error, atomic seed rollback, late seed after writes/deletion/clear, enumeration, and unavailable tables. Port behavioral coverage from ZAQ session_storage_test, adapting assertions to package contract.

Branches/paths validated:
New/existing entries, overwrites/deletes, capacity exhaustion, invalid scope/namespace/value, repeated seeding, cleared scope, transaction abort.

Mocking plan:
Use real internal storage, transactions, supervision and host boundaries. Inject fake WhatsApp network transport only at external provider boundary; isolated BEAMs for VM-wide Mnesia state. Configuration resolved at public boundaries; ZAQ runtime config uses Zaq.Config per policy.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Package backend module docs and callback contract; keep ZAQ docs unchanged until migration.

Action reuse assessment:
Extend Amarula.Storage callback interface and reuse existing SessionStorage algorithms by moving ownership. Local-only storage primitive; code callers only. No authorization inside generic backend: host wrapper must authorize before calls. Return sanitized typed errors for GuardedStorage.

Validation and E2E:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md and docs/testing-approach.md; package follows its own quality gate. No new UI or user journey: no new E2E authoring required. Implementation must preserve existing assertions and include property tests for isolation/idempotence/capacity invariants.

web_widget-influenced refinement (user-authorized plan update):
Configuration separation: backend callbacks consume an already configured/ready package runtime and never initialize the infrastructure as a side effect. Keep generic scope/namespace operations independent of ZAQ. The host wrapper decides which namespaces reach Mnesia; pairing credentials must not be rerouted by a package default. Add tests for missing/unready infrastructure and generation replacement. Durable storage routing remains ZAQ-owned.

Expanded upstream extraction scope (supersedes earlier references to retaining ZAQ Storage/Session): package owns temporary storage, pairing lifecycle, generic namespace routing/serialization and confirmation/handoff. ZAQ keeps only thin authorization/encrypted-persistence/connector callbacks in existing responsibility-compatible facades. All four modules under lib/zaq/channels/linked_device/ must be deleted; no equivalent state machine relocated elsewhere. Preserve this step's existing backend, lifecycle, rollout and validation requirements. New prerequisite issues cover the additional package and host API work.

comments.text: Implemented package Mnesia backend, bounded transactions, generation-bound handles and seed tombstones. Ported two property suites and backend tests; 2 properties/14 tests pass including isolated Mnesia stop/start recovery.
